name: S_pookie
source:
You find yourself in a speed dating event and get to sit with a cute girl, you have 5 minutes to win her over.

What happens if you fail to win her over?

[From [url=https://realpookie.itch.io/spookie]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一場快速聯誼活動中，坐到你對面的是個可愛的女孩。你有五分鐘讓她對你動心。

要是沒能打動她，會發生什麼呢？

（來源：[url=https://realpookie.itch.io/spookie]itch.io[/url]）
